privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.effective-for-description: Users in the European Economic Area (EEA), Switzerland, the United Kingdom, and the United States.
privacy-policy.intro-1: This Privacy Policy describes how {{companyName}} ("Company," "we," "us," or "our") collects, uses, and shares information when you use our Content Tree Management App (the "App").
privacy-policy.intro-2: By using the App, you agree to the terms of this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
privacy-policy.section-1-text: The App is an internal tool designed for enterprise use by authorized personnel. It is not intended for public use outside of {{companyName}} members. We prioritize transparency regarding your data and comply with major global privacy frameworks, including the GDPR (EU) and CCPA/CPRA (USA).
privacy-policy.section-2-intro: We collect information to provide authentication and service functionality:
privacy-policy.section-2a-item-1-text: Stored in our database for authentication. Passwords are hashed using strong algorithms (e.g., BCrypt) and never stored in plain text.
privacy-policy.section-2a-item-2-text: Any profile information you explicitly provide, if applicable.
privacy-policy.section-2b-item-1-text: IP address, browser type, operating system, and access timestamps.
privacy-policy.section-2b-item-2-text: Unique identifiers generated for each request to facilitate error diagnostics. These do not inherently identify you personally but allow us to correlate log entries if you report a technical issue.
privacy-policy.section-2b-item-3a-text: Authentication tokens (stored in localStorage) and security mechanisms required for the app to function securely.
privacy-policy.section-2b-item-3b-text: Language preference (stored in cookies or localStorage) and Theme selection (stored in localStorage). These are essential for your user experience.
privacy-policy.section-2-highlight-text: We do not use analytics, tracking cookies, or marketing pixels. We do not monitor your behavior across other websites. The data collected is strictly limited to service delivery and security debugging.
privacy-policy.section-3-intro: We use the collected information for the following purposes:
privacy-policy.section-3-item-1-label: To Provide and Maintain the Service
privacy-policy.section-3-item-1-text: Authenticating your access and rendering the UI according to your preferences.
privacy-policy.section-3-item-2-text: Responding to support requests or error reports (using Trace IDs).
privacy-policy.section-3-item-3-text: Monitoring for abuse, attacks, or unauthorized access via server logs.
privacy-policy.section-3-item-4-text: Complying with applicable laws in the EU, US, and other jurisdictions.
privacy-policy.section-4-intro: If you are in the EEA, our legal basis for processing your data is:
privacy-policy.section-4-item-1-text: Necessary to provide the App (e.g., authentication).
privacy-policy.section-4-item-2-text: Necessary for security, debugging, and system administration (e.g., logging IP addresses and Trace IDs).
privacy-policy.section-5-intro: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. We may share information only in the following cases:
privacy-policy.section-5-item-1-text: Third-party hosting providers (e.g., AWS, Azure) who process data on our behalf under strict Data Processing Agreements (DPAs).
privacy-policy.section-5-item-2-text: To comply with law, enforce terms, or protect rights.
privacy-policy.section-6a-item-1-text: Request a copy of your personal data.
privacy-policy.section-6a-item-3-text: Request deletion of your data ("Right to be Forgotten").
privacy-policy.section-6a-item-4-text: Limit how we process your data.
privacy-policy.section-6a-item-5-text: Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
privacy-policy.section-6a-item-6-text: Object to processing based on legitimate interest.
privacy-policy.section-6b-item-1-text: Request details about categories of personal information collected and sources.
privacy-policy.section-6b-item-2-text: Request deletion of personal information collected from you.
privacy-policy.section-6b-item-3-text: You have the right to opt-out of the sale or sharing of your personal information.
privacy-policy.section-6b-highlight-text: We DO NOT sell your personal information. Therefore, no opt-out mechanism is required for data sales. If you wish to exercise your Right to Delete or Know, please contact us below.
privacy-policy.section-6c-title: C. How to Exercise Your Rights
privacy-policy.section-6c-text: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the information provided in the "Contact Us" section below. When contacting us, please include your username and clearly state the specific request (e.g., "Request for Account Deletion"). We will verify your identity to ensure data security before processing your request.
privacy-policy.section-7-item-1-text: Retained while your account is active or as necessary to provide services. You may request deletion at any time.
privacy-policy.section-7-item-2-text_one: IP addresses and Trace IDs are retained for {{count}} day for security and debugging purposes, then anonymized or deleted.
privacy-policy.section-7-item-2-text_other: IP addresses and Trace IDs are retained for {{count}} days for security and debugging purposes, then anonymized or deleted.
privacy-policy.section-8-text: If we transfer your data outside the EEA/UK (e.g., to servers in the US), we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place, such as Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) or reliance on the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (if applicable).
privacy-policy.section-9-text: Our App is not intended for children under 13 (US) or 16 (EU). We do not knowingly collect data from children. If you believe a child has provided data, contact us immediately.
privacy-policy.section-10-text: We may update this policy periodically. We will notify you of significant changes by posting a notice on the App or via email.
